owner_path: POST /api/deployment/sagas/{saga_id}/failure failed_step=runtime_load_requested -> mark_binding_failed_inactive via deployment outbox consumer

served_case_rule.accepted: this run's case stays; all other active release cases retired
served_case_rule.compensated: newest other still-active release case stays; this run's case and older active cases retired

dry_run: docker exec -i pantheon-operator-bff-1 python - --dry-run --outcome accepted < scripts/retire_dev_paper_release_cases.py
limitation: consumer behaviour on an already-completed saga is verified only by reading outbox_consumer_worker.py; first hosted Root must confirm
